topSignals.title: Fourteenth consecutive quiet day — Elcogen now 26 days quiet, Topsoe 93 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated searches for both priority stacks (English and German), this cycle's Tier 2 rotation round 3 (Kyocera, Aisin) and sweep, the Tier 3 rotation (cycle 13, round 2: OxEon Energy, Nexceris, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Miura, Weichai, Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol) and a further Tier 3 sweep, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler (English and German), regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background (see notes below). Nothing confirmed beat or neared any row in SOFC_Benchmark_Records.md. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

topSignals.title: SPP's own FERC large-load show-cause answer (due Nov 20) still has not produced analyzable trade-press coverage — now eight days running.
topSignals.text: A direct check today of Southwest Power Pool-specific FERC coverage surfaced only the original June-July 2026 show-cause order background and the still-unfetchable Commissioner Lacerte concurrence item (Docket No. EL26-68), not SPP's actual filed answer. A separate Project Jupiter check (two direct-fetched Albuquerque Journal articles) reconfirmed the Dec 7 hearing vacatur (Nov 6) and Nov 23 deadline waiver remain the latest facts — no new hearing date set, still a schedule-risk item for order-book assumptions. For Dominic: no action needed on the LCOE model today. FERC Docket EL26-68

items.text: Elcogen (priority): 26 days quiet (since the Nov 2 Hygreen Energy MoU). No new item found today in English or German sources; results recirculated the already-logged May 2026 elcoStack E3000 G2 launch and the Metrosert testing-expansion deal.

Topsoe (priority): 93 days quiet on SOFC/SOEC specifically (since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset). No new item found today; Topsoe's press feed remains active but non-solid-oxide (SOEC-for-PtX, e-methanol, e-SAF, DKK 25M grid-access funding, DKK 4.4bn PtX restructuring) in both English and German searches.

Tier 2 dedicated rotation (Kyocera, Aisin — round 3 of current cycle): no new item for either; Kyocera's feed recirculated dateless SOFC-stack marketing material, Aisin's remained its standing non-SOFC-specific fuel-cell R&D history.

Tier 2 sweep ("Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra"): no new item; recycled Bloom's 2024-vintage 60% efficiency milestone and a dateless "Bloom Energy to supply Daroga Power" listing.

Tier 3 dedicated rotation (cycle 13, round 2: OxEon Energy, Nexceris, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Miura, Weichai, Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol): no new item for any of the six; recycled OxEon's/Nexceris's standing DOE-funding background, Kawasaki's hydrogen-combustion (non-SOFC) gas-engine work, Miura/Ceres's 4.2 kW CHP launch, Weichai's Ceres-licensed stationary-power background, and Fraunhofer IKTS's standing SOEC electrolysis-platform/degradation-study program.

Tier 3 sweep ("Reverion OR Convion OR Hexis OR Doosan Fuel Cell OR SK ecoplant"): no new item; recycled the Doosan/Reverion $76.7-78M SOFC stack-supply agreement and SK ecoplant's standing Korean heat-supply/localization background.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter, AEP/Google Cheyenne Fuel Cell LLC (702 MW/$4B, 20-yr PPA), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (28 MW, operational), NTT DATA (900 MW, global, shipments from 2027).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), Texas CRA (75 MW), SDCL (up to 450 MW). Also hosting the DOE/national-lab-backed StabilityMax R&D testbed in Danbury, CT. No named commercial deployment live yet.
Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B); supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment.

Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai, Denso, Thermax, + an unnamed EMEA licensee signed Nov 16, 2026): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly, and the EMEA licensee's remit is general EMEA-market manufacturing, not data-center-specific. Its identity remains undisclosed as of today.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
EGEN Energy (China, watch-list): Pre-commercial/early-stage; no named data-center customer yet.
